# domainchief_domain (Data Source)

Reads a domain in the team.

Requires a token with the `domainchief:domains:read` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "domainchief_domain" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

output "nameservers" {
  value = data.domainchief_domain.example.nameservers[*].hostname
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain name or domain ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) When the domain expires if it is not renewed.
- `id` (String) The ID of the domain.
- `is_autorenew_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the domain renews automatically.
- `is_dnssec_enabled` (Boolean) Whether DNSSEC is enabled, null when the TLD does not support it.
- `is_locked` (Boolean) Whether the domain is locked against transfers, null when the TLD does not support locking.
- `is_using_hosted_dns` (Boolean) Whether the domain uses Domain Chief hosted DNS. DNS records, web redirects and mail forwards can only be managed for domains using hosted DNS.
- `is_whois_privacy_enabled` (Boolean) Whether WHOIS privacy is enabled, null when the TLD does not support it.
- `mail_forward_status` (String) The mail forwarding status, mail forwards can only be managed when this is not `disabled`.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata attached to the domain.
- `nameservers` (Attributes List) The nameservers of the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nameservers))
- `renews_at` (String) When the domain renews, null when auto-renewal is disabled.
- `status` (String) The status of the domain, for example `active`.
- `unicode_domain` (String) The domain name as Unicode, differs from `domain` only for internationalized domain names.

<a id="nestedatt--nameservers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nameservers`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String) The hostname of the nameserver.
- `ipv4` (String) The IPv4 glue address, if any.
- `ipv6` (String) The IPv6 glue address, if any.
